questions.stem: Regarding Identity typography: a designer reviewing a community theater's playbill notices that a brand uses a completely different typeface on every new piece. What is the principal drawback of this practice?

options.text: The identity loses a recognizable typographic voice over time
Typefaces can never be combined with one another in any design
options.misconception: states a false prohibition about using multiple faces

options.text: Readability automatically improves whenever there is more variety

options.text: Different typefaces always carry exactly the same licensing cost

questions.learningObjective: evaluate mark distinctiveness in a design critique

options.text: It may confuse audiences and fail to distinguish the source
Similar marks are always illegal in every jurisdiction
options.misconception: states a legal absolute that the situation does not warrant
